items.title: Justice and Transformation within Rwanda
items.description: A book chapter by Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza exploring the ways Rwanda sought to bring those guilty of genocide to justice, published in 'In the Shadow of Genocide' (Routledge, 1st Edition, 2022). An open-access edition is available via Taylor & Francis.

items.title: Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza — Health, Human Rights & Peace Building (Blog)
items.description: Dr. Nkurunziza's personal blog, gathering his writings on health, human rights, peacebuilding and governance in Rwanda and across Africa.
